filter_bar.customer_scope: always visible; All / Unassigned / exact Customer Organization chooser
filter_bar.period: Daily / Weekly / Monthly; default from overview.default_period
filter_bar.rule: one filter state applies to every compatible card, preview, attention row, timeline and narrative item

section_order: Today / This period timeline and operational narrative
card_rules: Ticket and Objective headline values expose absolute trend arrow/delta against previous equivalent period
Inventory never flattens mixed lifecycle into one completion percentage; primary value is action-required count with constituent counts
SLA never maps an individual elapsed-duration crossing directly to cohort failure; cohort state comes from LLD-06
unknown/partial/unresolved/stale use text/icon semantics, never color alone
navigation: Every attention/timeline/activity item navigates to the owning LLD-10 workspace/workbench route; Overview exposes no mutation shortcut backed by cached state.
responsive: LLD-10 reflows cards/sections while preserving filter values, warnings, item order and navigation.
empty_state: A legitimate zero is shown only from complete owner coverage; unknown/partial coverage uses its explicit state instead of an empty-success illustration.
